_meta.note: English is the source language. Every other file must mirror these keys, and each entry needs reviewedBy set by a native speaker before that language can ship.

push.remind.body.text: It is time for your medicine. Tap here when you have taken it.

push.nudge.body.text: A reminder again: please take your medicine and tap here.

push.alert.body.missed.text: The medicine has not been confirmed yet. The reminder did reach the phone.

push.alert.body.offline.text: The medicine has not been confirmed yet. The phone seems to be offline.

push.broadcast.body.text: Nobody has responded to the missed medicine yet.

push.standDown.body.text: They are taking care of the missed medicine. You do not need to do anything.

push.tookLate.body.text: The medicine has now been confirmed as taken.

push.refill.body.text: This medicine is running low. Please arrange a refill.
